name: check-1-clusterrole-wildcard-verbs-and-resources
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: super-admin
rules:
- apiGroups: ["*"]
  resources: ["*"]
  verbs: ["*"]
reason: verbs and resources are both wildcard: Critical (Severity::Error)

name: check-1-role-wildcard-verbs-only
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: partial-wild
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["*"]
reason: wildcard verbs alone still flags, at Warning severity (not both wildcard)

name: check-1-role-wildcard-resources-only
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: partial-wild-res
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["*"]
  verbs: ["get"]
reason: wildcard resources alone still flags, at Warning severity

name: check-1-role-wildcard-apigroups-only
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: partial-wild-apigroup
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups: ["*"]
  resources: ["deployments"]
  verbs: ["get"]
reason: wildcard apiGroups alone still flags, at Warning severity

name: check-1-clusterrole-wildcard-non-resource-url
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: api-admin
rules:
- nonResourceURLs: ["*"]
  verbs: ["*"]
reason: wildcard nonResourceURLs with wildcard verbs grants unrestricted non-resource API access

name: check-1-clean-scoped-role
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: pod-reader
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get", "list"]
reason: fully scoped verbs/resources/apiGroups, no wildcard anywhere

name: check-2-clusterrolebinding-cluster-admin
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: everyone-admin
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: cluster-admin
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: default
  namespace: default

name: check-2-clean-clusterrolebinding-scoped-role
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: viewers
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: view
subjects:
- kind: Group
  name: developers
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
reason: roleRef.name is the built-in `view` role, not cluster-admin

name: check-2-clean-rolebinding-cluster-admin-name-wrong-kind
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: scoped
  namespace: default
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: cluster-admin
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: alice
reason: check-2 is scoped to ClusterRoleBinding kind only; RoleBinding is out of scope for this check

name: check-3-clusterrole-secrets-get-list-watch
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: secret-reader
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]

name: check-3-role-secrets-get-only
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: secret-getter
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
reason: get alone on secrets already grants read access to secret contents

name: check-3-clean-secrets-create-only
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: secret-writer
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["create"]
reason: create is not a read verb (get/list/watch/*) so no secrets-read finding

name: check-3-clean-other-resource-get
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: configmap-reader
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["configmaps"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
reason: read verbs on configmaps, not secrets, so no secrets-read finding

name: out-of-scope-kind-configmap
input:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
data:
  key: value
reason: ConfigMap is not an RBAC kind (Role/ClusterRole/RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding), so it is out of scope

name: out-of-scope-missing-kind
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: no-kind
rules:
- apiGroups: ["*"]
  resources: ["*"]
  verbs: ["*"]
reason: document has no `kind` field, so it cannot be recognized as an in-scope RBAC manifest

name: clean-rolebinding-no-rules-no-roleref-issue
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: bind-view
  namespace: default
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: view
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: bob
reason: RoleBinding to a scoped Role named `view`, no rules block to inspect and not a ClusterRoleBinding

name: rolebinding-cluster-admin-clusterrole
input:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: namespace-admin
  namespace: production
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: cluster-admin
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: alice
reason: RoleBinding to the cluster-admin ClusterRole grants full privilege within its namespace
